g.title: ERD_NOTES
g.text: PERSONS is the single source for names/contact; USERS is authentication/access.
Staff/Dentist account creation automatically synchronizes STAFF_PROFILES.
SERVICES + BRANCH_SERVICES + STAFF_SCHEDULES drive availability/conflict checks.
Templates assist documentation only; dentist retains clinical judgment.
Completed procedures generate invoice items; payment then produces receipt data.
Provider decides approval; system automates requirements, tracking, follow-up and escalation.
Analytics/dashboard are read/reporting layers over operational data and events.
Protected rules + events + action results power cross-module orchestration.
M24–M25 remain Proposed Enhancements and do not block core workflow.
